2.211.10
MapColorScale.LabelPlacement
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The MapColorScale.LabelPlacement element specifies the placement of labels in a MapColorScale.
This element is optional. If the MapColorScale.LabelPlacement element is present, its value MUST
be a String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.1) or an expression that evaluates to a String.
The value of this element MUST be one of the following or an expression that evaluates to one of the
following:
Alternate: Odd labels are positioned below the color bar, and even labels are positioned above the
color bar.
Top: All labels are positioned above the color bar.
Bottom: All labels are positioned below the color bar.
If this element is not present, its value is interpreted as "Alternate".
The following is the parent element of the MapColorScale.LabelPlacement element.
Parent elements
MapColorScale
The following is the XML Schema definition of the MapColorScale.LabelPlacement element.
 <xsd:element name="LabelPlacement" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
